objective: min system energy on common finite window under deadline/resource/domain/thermal constraints

execution.grid_applies_to: start only; do not round durations, deadlines or finish times

ordering.secondary_numeric_sort: unrounded finite numeric values, ascending; time tolerance only for legality

baseline.action: all actual starts at initial time, including Stage/unit/mode; empty set is wait
baseline.candidate_space: all legal no-heat complete schedules over all legal mode and energy layers
baseline.thermal_check: entire complete representative and idle tail
baseline.all_rejected: no_safe_representative, unless unresolved/time budget prevents conclusion
baseline.returned_plan: fixed full schedule, not event-by-event online replanning
baseline.noheat_generation_incomplete: unresolved; partial library is not an exact planner

thermal_verdict.unresolved: otherwise, including equality at either band boundary
thermal_verdict.evaluation: continuous constant-power segment extrema including endpoints/stationary points and tail

evaluation.cpu_heat: idle_cpu_total + sum increments of all running CPU-mapped stages
evaluation.npu_heat: idle_npu + increment of running NPU-mapped stage
evaluation.valid_energy_ranking: complete, resource/dependency/domain/grid/deadline legal, certified thermal safe

budget.timeout: retain certified witnesses/bounds and unresolved fields; never exclusion

reporting.symmetry: CPU label swaps are not mapping gains
reporting.baseline_gap: safe lower-energy independent witness proves a gap lower bound, not necessarily exact optimum
reporting.hot_case_outcomes: not predicted; no input changes to force failure or mapping changes

parameter_changes: never overwrite v1; any correction gets a new version and reason; no result-driven tuning
